implementation_rulings: Ruling: Execute only T4-B of the approved platform plan; T4-A is closed and T5-T8 remain future work — avoid repeating campaigns or evaluating test — cost if wrong: separate follow-up implementation.

Ruling: Q4 selection and updated plan override original neural-service spec — serve H with PostgreSQL, retain experimental dependencies — cost if wrong: service image remains larger until measured separation is justified.

Ruling: PostgreSQL persists version registry and active/previous pointer; one API process owns a PostgreSQL advisory lock, activation runs in that process via authenticated local admin endpoint — avoid stale workers and CLI-side memory divergence — cost if wrong: horizontal serving needs a new coordination contract.

Ruling: Freeze initial API limit at 4 GiB/2 CPU/2 threads, allow two immutable states during transition; measure full loading on mac24 before final capacity claims — T4-A construction peaked at 2.248 GiB — cost if wrong: valid resource failure blocks the remote sequence.
Ruling: Use a manual T4-B ledger within Task 4; the plan parser groups A/B into one task — cost if wrong: separate subsection status must be maintained.

Ruling: Use an isolated Docker staging directory under Documents because Colima does not mount native worktrees; images embed source and final verification runs without source mounts — cost if wrong: source provenance must be checked before handoff.

Ruling: Administrative calls use the locally generated application credential via container-local CLI; no token in arguments, reports or public examples — cost if wrong: a separately scoped admin credential may be needed if exposure expands beyond localhost.

Ruling: Full registry load and sampled HTTP parity run on mac24; T4-A already checked exact offline top200 for all V3 buyers. T4-B probes at most 257 known/unknown buyers plus filters, and does not evaluate labels — cost if wrong: this is not exhaustive HTTP parity or the T8 load benchmark.

Ruling: Keep serving-check foreground with closed evidence on normal failure/interruption, explicit clean SHA and two passed T4-A source packages. API remains on candidate after successful restart/rollback checks — cost if wrong: abrupt host loss needs inspection of incomplete state; no automatic retry.

Ruling: For local rehearsal only, reproduce mac24's synthetic package with archived d59e147 builder and original synthetic dataset; manifest hash matches the downloaded closed report exactly. No H&M job or quality campaign repeated — cost if wrong: the local rehearsal measures only synthetic serving.
Final: Ruling: Full H&M memory capacity and reproduction remain pending mac24 — synthetic success cannot establish full resident memory; cost if wrong: remote failure blocks T4-B closure.

Final: Ruling: Sustained throughput, p95 and final quality acceptance remain T8 — current probe is sequential and does not read labels; cost if wrong: no production capacity or final quality claim yet.
Final: Ruling: Events/UI/scheduling/portable backup remain T5–T7 — preserve approved sequencing and current private packages; cost if wrong: this delivery alone is not the complete platform.

Final: Ruling: Retain scientific dependencies in the locked image — runtime import test proves API does not load Torch/Qdrant/MLflow, image minimization is deferred; cost if wrong: larger image and rebuild/download cost.

Final: Ruling: Finish evidence/status docs after measured rehearsal — reviewer excluded draft metadata and it must reflect actual observations; cost if wrong: documentation errors can misdirect the next agent.
